sequence.description: Kevin McGonigle homers (11) on a fly ball to left field.
Gleyber Torres singles on a ground ball to left fielder Tyler Soderstrom.
Dillon Dingler singles on a line drive to left fielder Tyler Soderstrom. Gleyber Torres to 2nd.
Riley Greene flies out to left fielder Tyler Soderstrom.
Colt Keith singles on a ground ball to right fielder Lawrence Butler. Gleyber Torres scores. Dillon Dingler to 3rd.
Jacob Wilson grounds out to first baseman Spencer Torkelson.
Tyler Soderstrom singles on a ground ball to left fielder Riley Greene.
Tommy White singles on a line drive to right fielder Zach McKinstry. Tyler Soderstrom to 3rd.
Lawrence Butler grounds out to first baseman Spencer Torkelson.
